accepted_findings.reason: Single-tenant operator image: root simplifies bind mounts and entrypoint (Alembic, uvicorn). Non-root USER can be added later when volume UIDs are aligned.
Same as missing-user-entrypoint: intentional root in this image; restrict exposure at the network / orchestration layer.
Default AGENT_CORS_ORIGINS=* is for local/dev; production sets explicit origins via env. Documented in .env.example and lifespan warning.

Dynamic SQL builds fixed clause shapes (OR/SET fragments); user-derived values use %s placeholders. Memory-graph keyword branch repeats (label ILIKE %s OR summary ILIKE %s) per token—tokens never interpolated as SQL keywords.

accepted_findings.message_regex: Avoiding SQL string concatenation|raw query|SQL string|concatenat
accepted_findings.reason: Alembic migration downgrade: `op.execute(f"ALTER TABLE … DROP COLUMN … {col}")` where `col` is iterated from a fixed tuple in this file only—no runtime user input.
Alembic migration: column names come from a fixed tuple in the migration file, not from HTTP input.
Workflow modules build LLM prompts for the product; user-derived content is inherent to an agent server and bounded by auth and tool policies.
Operator-only CLI scripts: URL is AGENT_BASE_URL plus fixed API path (http/https). Same as Bandit B310; line-level nosec in source.
Paths are dashboard dataPath strings; __proto__/constructor/prototype segments are now rejected. Residual scanner noise may remain on older branches.
False positive: Python config file; line ~262 is a comment about CDP (mentions ws:// in prose). No browser WebSocket API in this file.

Meta-false-positive: Semgrep scans this JSON policy file; strings such as WebSocket/wss appear in documented reasons (e.g. config.py FP), not in executable JS. Exclude scanning this path or accept via policy.
Same trust model as Bandit B310: HTTP(S) CDP /json/version only; base URL normalized to http/https.
Static argv for pip and playwright install; env paths from operator (PIDEA_PLAYWRIGHT_PIP_TARGET), not request body. Matches Bandit B603 policy.
Pytest and unit tests use asserts; excluded from production Bandit scope via pyproject.toml exclude_dirs as well.
Internal invariants or operator-only tool paths; not a production security boundary under python -O.
Optional shutdown (incl. lifespan / bridge stop), best-effort parsing, or non-fatal cleanup; failures are logged where relevant or impact is benign.
Scheduled job discovery skips broken modules intentionally.
Message iteration skips malformed parts; bounded IMAP parsing.
OAuth token_type string 'bearer' in JSON responses, not a password.
Heuristic false positive on JSON null / display text 'None', not a credential.
User-facing curl examples and placeholder JSON for OTP registration (DEINE_MAIL, private-XXXX, etc.), not real secrets.
User secret service_key name for stored PAT, not an embedded credential.
Service key / tool domain identifier, not a password string.
random.randint used for ComfyUI KSampler seed variation, not cryptography.
f-string only joins fixed SQL fragments; values use %s placeholders. Memory graph keyword OR clause repeats parameterized ILIKE patterns per token.
Operator CLI: urllib opens HTTP(S) URLs built from AGENT_BASE_URL + fixed API paths; not arbitrary file:// from user input. nosec on urlopen line.
CDP HTTP(S) only: _normalize_cdp_base forces http:// or https:// before urljoin + urlopen to local IDE debugging endpoint (operator-controlled PIDEA_CDP_HTTP_URL), not user-controlled file://.
PIDEA chat readers: skip bad frames/lines in bounded loops; continue is intentional.
Validator skips invalid selector rows; bounded iteration.
Playwright teardown: best-effort close/stop; errors during shutdown are non-fatal.
Optional page.url read when CDP page may be closing; failure is non-fatal for status payload.
Server-side pip/playwright install uses fixed argv (sys.executable -m pip/playwright); no user-controlled shell strings.
Same as B404: subprocess.run with static command list and env derived from operator config paths (PIDEA_PLAYWRIGHT_PIP_TARGET), not remote user input.

Intentional agent coding tool: shell=True required for pipes/redirections in one-liners. cwd locked to bound workspace; workdir must be relative under root; _is_blocked denylist rejects destructive patterns (rm -rf /, curl|sh, fork bomb, etc.). Authenticated tool-governed surface, not anonymous shell.
Runs operator-configured verify_command from workspace DB row only (model cannot supply arbitrary command). Reuses coding_bash _is_blocked; cwd locked to workspace root; bounded timeout.
Paths resolved under configured tool roots (AGENT_TOOLS_EXTRA_DIR / image tools); authenticated admin/tool-governed surface, not arbitrary anonymous FS write.
Admin-only POST /v1/admin/rag/ingest-docs; docs_root is admin-controlled; resolved with Path.expanduser().resolve() for server-side ingest.
Selector JSON paths are under repo selectors/<ide>/<version>.json; resolve_version validates file exists; ide/version normalized. Admin/operator surface.
Loads selector bundles from fixed selectors/ tree; paths derived from validated ide/version, not arbitrary FS reads from chat users.

Logs LLM model id (renamed in format strings to llm_model_id=), redacted assistant preview via _redact_secrets_for_log, and redacted/truncated provider error bodies via _redact_provider_error_text_for_log. CodeQL py/clear-text-logging-sensitive-data often misclassifies model identifiers or JSON error fragments as password material.
POST URL is supplied by server config (Ollama base URL, llama.cpp OpenAI server, operator external LLM endpoints), not arbitrary per-request user URLs in the default deployment model.
Allowlist-style host checks for ICS fetch policy; documented residual heuristic limitation.
External LLM base URL normalization uses allowlisted host substrings; known trade-off for Google OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

CodeQL dataflow: exception flows to HTTPException detail via http_500_detail(e), which returns generic text unless operator_settings.expose_internal_errors is true. logger.exception is server-only; no traceback string in JSON responses.

Admin-only RAG: client 500 uses http_500_detail; 502 messages use generic strings unless expose_internal_errors. ValueError/FileNotFoundError handlers use str(e) for validation/path errors (admin). logger.exception does not emit tracebacks to clients.
Admin routes: reload-tools and tool-policies use http_500_detail for 500s. create-tool JSON decode failure returns constant detail string; logger.exception is server-side only.
Authenticated POST /v1/codebase/index: body.root is expanduser().resolve()'d and must exist as a directory; when CODING_ROOT is set, path must be under that operator-configured root (403 otherwise).

Workspace materialization under AGENTLAYER_WORKSPACE_PATH/{owner_user_id}/{name}: validate_workspace_name rejects path separators and . / .. segments; resolve_user_workspace_dir enforces relative_to(user_root) before mkdir/clone. Authenticated per-user tenancy.
Workspace FS browse/read endpoints resolve user path query via safe_resolve_under_workspace (rejects absolute paths and .. escapes after resolve()); owner-scoped workspace_id from DB.

Heuristic regex on bounded chat/assistant text (_infer_shell_command_from_user_text, _strip_prose_fake_tool_markup): input length capped by conversation limits; patterns use non-greedy groups or fixed prefixes—not attacker-controlled catastrophic backtracking in practice.
First-start email validation uses anchored simple pattern ^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$ with no nested quantifiers; CodeQL ReDoS heuristic is a false positive on this fixed regex.

sha256 of normalized user_query is an analytics fingerprint for memory-graph activation logging (query_sha256 column); docstring states no raw query text is stored. Not password hashing—CodeQL mislabels chat query text as password material.
Logs agent_id and tool name lists from registry (all_tools[:20], mapped_tools[:30]); no credentials. CodeQL taint from tool/function names containing substrings like 'password' in unrelated fields.
warning logs sorted capability hint strings when filter matches no tools; hints are capability tokens, not user secrets.
info log emits only integer counts (heuristic redactions, vault placeholder count) after scrubbing user message content—not the scrubbed text or vault values.
Logs resolved LLM model id, routing reason, and bearer_user_role strings for operator diagnostics; no API keys or passwords in log arguments.
JSON preset field run_key / comfy_txt2img_default matches generic secret heuristic; not an API key.
